title.zh: 化石燃料之争使COP31气候谈判陷入僵局
title.en: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

summary.zh: 近200个国家在争取达成新的全球气候协议时陷入僵局，分歧核心涉及化石燃料。谈判进展受阻，各方仍需协调立场。
summary.en: Nearly 200 countries remain deadlocked in efforts to reach a new global climate agreement, with fossil fuels a central sticking point. Talks are stalled as negotiators seek to bridge differences.

reports.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

title.zh: 用Lean形式化验证黎曼猜想
title.en: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis

summary.zh: Lean证明助手社区发布博文，介绍对黎曼猜想进行形式化验证的相关工作。该进展引发数学与形式化方法领域的广泛关注和讨论。
summary.en: The Lean prover community published a post on efforts to formally verify the Riemann Hypothesis. The work has drawn wide attention and debate among mathematicians and formal-methods researchers.

reports.title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis

title.zh: 软银孙正义曾探讨以1万亿美元收购SK海力士
title.en: SoftBank’s Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix, the Information reports - Reuters

summary.zh: 据The Information报道，软银创始人孙正义曾探讨以约1万亿美元收购韩国芯片制造商SK海力士。该交易尚处探讨阶段，未见落实。
summary.en: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son explored a $1 trillion buyout of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix, The Information reported, according to Reuters. The reported plan was exploratory and no deal was confirmed.

reports.title: SoftBank’s Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix, the Information reports - Reuters
融资收购SK海力士？孙正义一度考虑“万亿豪赌”，已接洽华尔街 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 特朗普威胁对在海外建数据中心的美国科技公司征收“巨额处罚”
title.en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

summary.zh: 特朗普称将对在美国境外建设数据中心的美国科技公司施加“巨额处罚”，但未说明细节，并称尚未告知本国官员。他还在白宫记者会上谈及与普京、习近平的关系，并表示将调查有关伊朗的报道。
summary.en: Trump threatened “tremendous penalties” on US tech companies building datacenters abroad but gave no details and said he had not informed his own officials. He also discussed ties with Putin and Xi and said he would look into a report on Iran.

reports.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

title.zh: 胰腺癌口服药被誉为“数十年来最大突破”
title.en: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades'

summary.zh: 一款名为daraxonrasib的口服药物在胰腺癌治疗上取得突破，被专家称为数十年来该领域的最大进展。该药物针对特定基因突变，有望改变这种高致死率癌症的治疗格局。
summary.en: An oral drug called daraxonrasib has shown a major breakthrough in treating pancreatic cancer, described by experts as the biggest advance in decades. The pill targets specific genetic mutations and could reshape care for one of the deadliest cancers.

reports.title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades'

title.zh: 美国证交会对英伟达的调查聚焦潜在会计问题
title.en: US SEC's Nvidia probe is examining potential accounting issues – sources

summary.zh: 据消息人士透露，美国证券交易委员会对英伟达的调查正在审查其可能存在的会计问题。调查具体范围尚未公开，英伟达方面暂未作详细回应。
summary.en: Sources say the US Securities and Exchange Commission's probe into Nvidia is examining potential accounting issues. The specific scope of the investigation has not been made public, and Nvidia has not offered a detailed response.

reports.title: US SEC's Nvidia probe is examining potential accounting issues – sources
美国证券交易委员会据悉正对英伟达潜在会计问题展开调查 - Jiemian.com
英伟达再遭SEC调查，会计问题是审查重点，股价已较10月高点腰斩 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 特朗普称只应向中国出售旧款芯片
title.en: Trump says only older chips should be sold to China - Reuters

summary.zh: 特朗普表示，美国只应向中国出售较旧型号的芯片，暗示将收紧先进半导体对华出口。此举可能影响美中科技贸易。
summary.en: Trump said only older chips should be sold to China, suggesting tighter limits on advanced semiconductor exports. The remark could affect US-China technology trade.

reports.title: Trump says only older chips should be sold to China - Reuters

title.zh: 韩国教育部长因AI作弊丑闻辞职
title.en: South Korea education minister resigns after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams

summary.zh: 韩国教育部长官崔教镇辞职，称对高考准备不足。此前一名税务会计师考试最高分者承认使用微型摄像头和智能设备作弊，引发对AI辅助考试作弊的担忧；今年高考禁止携带手机并检查衣物内隐藏摄像头。
summary.en: South Korea's education minister resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal ahead of key university entrance exams. A top scorer in a national tax accountant exam admitted using a miniature camera and smart device, fueling fears. Phones were banned and clothing checked for hidden cameras this year.

reports.title: South Korea education minister resigns after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams

title.zh: 据报道FBI正调查其犯罪数据库疑似遭黑客入侵
title.en: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database

summary.zh: 据报道，美国联邦调查局正在调查国家犯罪信息中心数据库疑似遭黑客入侵事件。该数据库供联邦和地方执法机构共享信息，事件引发安全担忧。
summary.en: The FBI is reportedly investigating an apparent hack of its National Crime Information Center database, which federal and local law enforcement use to share information. The incident raises security concerns.

reports.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
Trump says there could be a 'positive spin' from the latest FBI database hack

title.zh: 俄罗斯货船在波罗的海遭无人机袭击起火，船员撤离
title.en: Russian cargo ship ablaze in Baltic Sea after drone strike, crew evacuates - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，一艘俄罗斯货船在波罗的海遭无人机袭击后起火，船员已撤离。事件具体细节尚待进一步确认。
summary.en: A Russian cargo ship caught fire in the Baltic Sea after a drone strike, and its crew evacuated, Reuters reported. Further details were not immediately available.

reports.title: Russian cargo ship ablaze in Baltic Sea after drone strike, crew evacuates - Reuters

title.zh: 联合国未能就监管“杀手机器人”规则达成一致
title.en: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’

summary.zh: 在日内瓦举行的联合国谈判未能就自主武器（即“杀手机器人”）的使用规则达成协议。经过一周收效甚微的磋商，各方仅同意“开始讨论各种选项”。
summary.en: UN talks in Geneva ended without agreement on rules governing autonomous weapons, or so-called killer robots. After a largely fruitless week of negotiations, representatives only agreed to start discussing options.

reports.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’

title.zh: Inkling-2-Mini 模型仅需 5.4 GB 内存运行
title.en: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory

summary.zh: 一位开发者展示了如何在仅 5.4 GB 内存的条件下运行 Inkling-2-Mini 模型。该项目通过量化与工程优化，降低了大模型本地部署的硬件门槛。
summary.en: A developer demonstrates running the Inkling-2-Mini model within just 5.4 GB of memory. The project uses quantization and engineering optimizations to lower the hardware bar for local model deployment.

reports.title: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory

title.zh: 墨西哥贩毒集团头目“矮子伊斯德罗”在特种部队突袭中落网
title.en: Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid

summary.zh: 墨西哥军方在锡那罗亚州特种部队突袭中抓获FBI十大通缉犯之一、“矮子伊斯德罗”伊斯德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯及其两名团伙头目。瓜萨韦市枪战引发恐慌，他已潜逃十余年。
summary.en: Mexico's military captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” one of the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives, in a special forces raid in Sinaloa. Two alleged gang leaders were also arrested after a gun battle that caused panic in Guasave. He had evaded capture for over a decade.

reports.title: Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid
Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out

title.zh: 泽连斯基称袭击克里米亚大桥是“公平回应”，并会见英国官员斯特里廷
title.en: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting

summary.zh: 泽连斯基表示，在俄罗斯对乌克兰桥梁发动109次空袭后，乌方对克里米亚大桥的打击是“公平回应”。他在会见英国官员斯特里廷时作出上述表态。
summary.en: Zelensky called strikes on the Crimean Bridge a “fair response,” saying Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges. He spoke while meeting UK’s Streeting.

reports.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting

title.zh: 中国承诺推进低碳电气化并帮助他国改善
title.en: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve

summary.zh: 中国代表团高级成员在COP31气候峰会上表示，中国将推动以低碳能源实现经济快速电气化，并帮助其他国家同样推进。会上敦促各国承诺到2035年使35%的能源来自电力。
summary.en: A senior Chinese delegate at the COP31 climate summit said China is pushing rapid electrification of its economy using low-carbon energy and will help other countries do the same. Countries are being urged to commit to deriving 35% of their energy from electricity by 2035.

reports.title: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve

title.zh: 中石油集团副总经理谢军被查 长期任职西南油气田
title.en: CNPC deputy general manager Xie Jun placed under investigation; long served in Southwest Oil and Gas Field

summary.zh: 据财新报道，中国石油集团副总经理谢军涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受审查调查。谢军长期在西南油气田系统任职，此次被查属能源央企高层人事变动，具体案情尚未公布。
summary.en: Xie Jun, a deputy general manager of China National Petroleum Corporation, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation, Caixin reported. Xie spent much of his career in the company's Southwest Oil and Gas Field unit; no details of the case have been disclosed.

reports.title: 中石油集团副总经理谢军被查 长期任职西南油气田 - 财新
中国石油天然气集团有限公司党组成员、副总经理谢军被查 - 第一财经

title.zh: 今年流感季三种毒株同时活跃，跨毒株感染风险上升
title.en: Three flu strains circulating at once this season, raising cross-strain infection risk

summary.zh: Multiple influenza strains are circulating simultaneously this season, raising the risk of repeat infection with different strains. The report calls for stronger prevention measures and vaccination.
summary.en: Three influenza strains are circulating simultaneously this season, raising the risk of cross-strain infection, Jiemian.com reported. The co-circulation may complicate prevention, diagnosis and treatment, highlighting the need for vaccination and personal precautions.

reports.title: 今年流感跨毒株感染风险加大，今年流感季三毒株同时活跃 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 加沙卫生部称以色列袭击车辆致三人死亡
title.en: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says - Reuters

summary.zh: 加沙卫生部称，以色列在加沙对一辆汽车发动袭击，造成三人死亡。目前事件细节有限，以方未立即作出回应。
summary.en: Gaza's Health Ministry said an Israeli strike on a vehicle in Gaza killed three people. Details were limited and there was no immediate Israeli comment.

reports.title: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says - Reuters

title.zh: 丹麦在挫败阴谋后推动欧盟收紧对俄旅行限制
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Denmark pushes EU to tighten travel curbs on Russians after foiled plot - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，丹麦在挫败一起阴谋后，正推动欧盟收紧对俄罗斯人的旅行限制。此举可能影响申根区入境政策，相关讨论仍在进行。
summary.en: Denmark is pushing the EU to tighten travel restrictions on Russians after a foiled plot, Reuters reported. The move could affect Schengen entry rules as discussions continue.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Denmark pushes EU to tighten travel curbs on Russians after foiled plot - Reuters

title.zh: 萨尔瓦多部队打击黑帮，海地人既兴奋又不安
title.en: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs

summary.zh: 萨尔瓦多部队进驻太子港打击黑帮，多年被黑帮控制后，不少当地民众表示欢迎，但也有人担忧军事行动可能加剧局势动荡。市内主要足球场长期停用，城市大片区域在2024年曾被武装黑帮占据。
summary.en: Foreign combatants have arrived in Port-au-Prince to fight gangs, welcomed by many Haitians after years of gang control, though some fear the offensive could worsen an already volatile situation. The city's main football stadium has stood unused for over two years.

reports.title: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs

title.zh: 财新观察：亚太如何回答时代课题
title.en: Caixin View: How the Asia-Pacific answers the questions of our time

summary.zh: 财新评论文章聚焦亚太地区在当下国际环境中面临的共同议题与合作路径。文章讨论区域各方如何回应增长、安全与治理等时代课题。
summary.en: A Caixin commentary examines the shared challenges and cooperation paths facing the Asia-Pacific region. It discusses how regional players can respond to questions of growth, security and governance.

reports.title: 财新观察｜亚太回答时代课题 - 财新

title.zh: Signal限制手机截图，应对AI监控的“生存威胁”
title.en: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance

summary.zh: Signal在安卓和iOS应用中都限制了用户的截图功能。该举措被视为对AI驱动的大规模监控威胁的回应，可能影响用户分享聊天内容的便利性。
summary.en: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps. The move is framed as a response to the existential threat of AI-driven surveillance, though it may reduce convenience for sharing chats.

reports.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance

title.zh: Upload2Shell（CVE-2026-125396）
title.en: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)

summary.zh: 安全研究页面披露编号 CVE-2026-125396 的 Upload2Shell 漏洞，讨论文件上传功能可能被利用获取 shell 的风险。
summary.en: A security disclosure covers Upload2Shell, tracked as CVE-2026-125396. The post examines risks tied to upload functionality potentially leading to shell access.

reports.title: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)

title.zh: Anthropic 能负担得起安全优先吗？
title.en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

summary.zh: 播客讨论 Anthropic 上市后能否继续坚持安全优先，聚焦 Claude 开发商在商业压力与安全投入之间的取舍。此为“AI 在现实生活”系列最后一集。
summary.en: A podcast discusses Anthropic’s IPO and whether the Claude maker can keep safety first amid commercial pressures. It is the final episode in a series on AI in real life.

reports.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

title.zh: 陆家嘴金融沙龙：人工智能重塑公募投研生态的观察、机遇与挑战
title.en: Lujiazui Financial Salon: AI reshapes public fund research ecosystem—observations, opportunities and challenges

summary.zh: 陆家嘴金融沙龙围绕人工智能如何重塑公募基金投研生态展开讨论。与会者分析了AI在投研流程中的应用前景，以及由此带来的机遇与挑战。
summary.en: A Lujiazui financial salon discussed how artificial intelligence is reshaping investment research at Chinese public fund firms. Participants examined applications across the research process along with the opportunities and challenges involved.

reports.title: 陆家嘴金融沙龙：人工智能重塑公募投研新生态——观察、机遇与挑战 - 第一财经

title.zh: 我的显示器把下载速度降低了 75%
title.en: My monitor was cutting my download speed by 75%

summary.zh: 作者排查发现，显示器相关的以太网连接使下载速度下降约 75%，并记录了定位与解决过程。
summary.en: The author found that a monitor-related Ethernet setup was cutting download speeds by about 75%. The post walks through the troubleshooting and fix.

reports.title: My monitor was cutting my download speed by 75%

title.zh: 特朗普称普京为朋友后，泽连斯基称普京是“杀手”
title.en: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend

summary.zh: 泽连斯基以“杀手”形容普京，回应特朗普此前称俄美领导人关系良好。本周早些时候，特朗普在中国一场会晤前迎接普京，并称两人关系“非常好”。
summary.en: Zelensky called Putin a "killer" after Trump described the Russian leader as a friend. Earlier this week Trump greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the pair have a "great relationship".

reports.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend

title.zh: 中国洗衣机为何未能打开15亿人口的非洲市场
title.en: Why haven't Chinese washing machines won Africa's 1.5 billion-person market?

summary.zh: 报道分析了中国洗衣机企业在非洲市场渗透率偏低的现状。文章从购买力、电力与供水等基础设施，以及渠道和售后网络等方面，探讨制约因素。
summary.en: The report examines why Chinese washing-machine makers have made limited inroads in Africa. It cites low purchasing power, unreliable power and water infrastructure, and weak distribution and after-sales networks as key obstacles.

reports.title: 中国洗衣机，为什么没拿下15亿人的非洲市场？ - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 美国解密更多在中东拍摄的UFO视频
title.en: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East

summary.zh: 五角大楼公布第八批不明飞行物相关记录，其中包括三段分别拍摄于2020年、2023年和2026年的视频片段。此举延续了美方近年逐步公开此类资料的进程。
summary.en: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, including three video clips filmed in 2020, 2023 and 2026. The release continues the US military's gradual disclosure of such material.

reports.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East

title.zh: 我们把开发者提拔为架构师，却没有告知他们
title.en: We promoted developers into architects without informing them

summary.zh: 文章讨论公司未充分沟通便将开发者转为架构师，造成职责不清、角色错位和管理摩擦。
summary.en: The article examines companies promoting developers into architect roles without clear communication or preparation. It highlights resulting role confusion, unclear responsibilities, and management friction.

reports.title: We promoted developers into architects without informing them

title.zh: 推理提供商上的数据处理事件
title.en: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers

summary.zh: OpenRouter 公告称部分推理提供商发生数据处理事件，并说明相关影响与应对措施。
summary.en: OpenRouter announced data-processing incidents at some inference providers. The notice outlines the impact and response.

reports.title: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers

title.zh: 两个截然不同的英伟达
title.en: A tale of two Nvidias

summary.zh: 英伟达最新财报与部分科技高管公开呼吁黄仁勋“回归”的言论，勾勒出关于这家公司的两种截然不同的图景。报道对比了资本市场视角与业界人士态度之间的落差。
summary.en: Nvidia's latest earnings report and tech executives publicly calling for Jensen Huang's return present two very different pictures of the company. The contrast highlights a gap between market results and industry sentiment.

reports.title: A tale of two Nvidias

title.zh: Pandex：通过 MCP 面向 AI 代理的欧洲官方法律
title.en: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP

summary.zh: Pandex 提供通过 MCP 访问的欧洲法律信息，面向 AI 代理的合规与法律查询场景。
summary.en: Pandex offers European law information for AI agents via MCP. It targets legal lookup and compliance use cases.

reports.title: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP

title.zh: 引爆一大堆叠氮化铅
title.en: Detonating a pile of lead azide

summary.zh: 《科学》网站博客文章讨论引爆大量叠氮化铅（一种极敏感起爆药）的实操与风险，并在黑客新闻上引发热议，获得约570点热度、370条评论。
summary.en: A Science magazine blog post examines what happens when a large pile of lead azide, a highly sensitive primary explosive, is detonated. The piece drew about 570 points and 370 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: Detonating a pile of lead azide

title.zh: 极氪法务部辟谣“召回”短信：系冒名诈骗
title.en: Zeekr legal department refutes "recall" SMS as impersonation scam

summary.zh: 极氪法务部就网传“召回”短信发布声明，称相关短信系他人冒用公司名义发送的诈骗信息，并非官方通知。公司提醒车主提高警惕，勿轻信陌生来源信息，避免泄露个人信息或造成财产损失。
summary.en: Zeekr's legal department said text messages circulating about a vehicle "recall" were sent fraudulently in the company's name and were not official notices. The automaker urged owners to stay alert and avoid sharing personal information with unknown senders.

reports.title: 极氪法务部辟谣“召回”短信：系冒名诈骗 - 第一财经

title.zh: NINLIVE：九寸钉乐队现场演出档案库
title.en: NINLIVE: The Nine Inch Nails live archive

summary.zh: NINLIVE 是一个收录九寸钉乐队（Nine Inch Nails）现场演出的在线档案网站，提供演出录音等资料。该资源在黑客新闻上获得约365点热度、104条评论。
summary.en: NINLIVE is an online archive of Nine Inch Nails live recordings and concert material. The site drew about 365 points and 104 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: NINLIVE: The Nine Inch Nails live archive

title.zh: 神秘“暗彗星”加速异常，天文学家仍无解
title.en: Weirdly accelerating space rock keeps puzzling astronomers

summary.zh: 编号1998 KY26的“暗彗星”运动方式异常，其加速原因至今没有令人满意的解释。日本探测器原计划2031年造访，却因发动机故障无法成行，谜团因此继续悬置。这条新闻值得深读，因为它关乎人类对太阳系小天体性质的基本认知，也牵动未来行星防御与深空探测的规划。
summary.en: The dark comet 1998 KY26 is moving in ways scientists cannot fully explain, and the anomaly remains unresolved. A Japanese probe was meant to visit it in 2031, but engine trouble has cancelled that encounter. Worth reading because the mystery touches basic questions about small bodies in the solar system and about planning future deep-space and planetary-defence missions.

title.zh: 《制衡》通讯：2028年总统选战的拥挤赛道
title.en: Checks and Balance newsletter: The crowded field for 2028

summary.zh: 《经济学人》美国版编辑夏洛特·霍华德撰文，梳理众多有意角逐2028年总统大选的人选如何在拥挤的赛道上争取辨识度。文章关注各人设定位、议题选择与早期布局。距投票尚远，但候选人卡位的信号已能反映两党内部力量走向，因此值得关注早期动向的读者一读。
summary.en: Charlotte Howard, The Economist's US editor, examines how a crowded field of presidential hopefuls is trying to stand out ahead of 2028. The newsletter looks at early positioning, message choices and the signals these moves send about both parties. Worth reading to understand how the next presidential race is already taking shape.

title.zh: 真正的科技成瘾者
title.en: The real tech addicts

summary.zh: 文章探讨为何有些人会深陷数字世界难以自拔，并追问成瘾背后的个人心理与社会环境因素。它试图区分普遍的重度使用与真正的成瘾行为，检视相关证据与解释。在屏幕时间之争日益激烈的当下，这一视角有助于读者重新审视自身与他人的数字习惯。
summary.en: Why do some people fall down the digital rabbit hole while others do not? The piece asks what separates heavy use from genuine addiction and looks at the psychology and circumstances behind it. Worth reading as debates over screen time intensify and the question of harm becomes more contested.

title.zh: 其他行星闻起来是什么味道？答案藏在化学里
title.en: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry

summary.zh: 人类大概永远无法亲鼻嗅闻其他行星，但科学家可以通过大气与表面的化学成分推断其气味特征。文章解释这些推断如何做出，以及它们的可靠边界。这类科普既能满足好奇，也展示了行星化学如何把看不见的数据转译为可感知的图景。
summary.en: We will probably never sniff another planet, but that does not stop scientists from guessing. The piece explains how atmospheric and surface chemistry can be translated into imagined smells, and where such inferences reach their limits. Worth reading as a vivid example of how planetary science turns remote data into something tangible.
